detail.longDescription: Happy Bridgetown fundraising day! 🥳 We've just announced new goal tiers to help focus on what we're trying to accomplish as we build up a sustainable financial picture. It's not hyperbole to state that continued maintenance and feature development of the Bridgetown # WebDev framework for handcoders is at risk. Please help spread the word, and do what you can…even if it's just to tell a # Ruby friend. Thank you so much for your support! 🙏 https://www. bridgetownrb.com/news/fundrais ing-to-save-bridgetown/
